name: Front Lever Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, straight arms, and your entire body locked in a tight hollow line.
Depress your shoulder blades and pull downward through your straight arms using your lats and core to sweep your rigid body upward toward horizontal.
Pause briefly when your body reaches parallel to the floor or as high as you can maintain strict straight-body alignment.
Lower your body slowly back down to a controlled dead hang without swinging.
tips: Keep your arms straight throughout the entire lift rather than bending at the elbows.
Avoid kipping or bending at the hips as you initiate each repetition.
